definitions.explanation: A person who has reached the age of majority.
The process or event of reaching adulthood.

examples.japanese: {成人|せいじん}{式|しき}に{参加|さんか}した。
{日本|にほん}では{十八歳|じゅうはっさい}で{成人|せいじん}になる。
examples.english: In Japan, you become an adult at 18.

examples.japanese: {成人|せいじん}{向|む}けの{映画|えいが}だ。
examples.english: This is a movie for adults.

notes:
{成人|せいじん} refers to adults and the process of becoming an adult.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ} (Coming of Age Day) is a national holiday in Japan held on the second Monday of January. Young people who turned 20 (or now 18, after the 2022 law change) during the year celebrate with ceremonies and often wear traditional clothing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成人|せいじん}{式|しき} (coming-of-age ceremony)
- {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ} (Coming of Age Day)
- {成人|せいじん}{向|む}け (for adults)
- {成人|せいじん}{病|びょう} (adult diseases/lifestyle diseases)
- {成人|せいじん}{年齢|ねんれい} (age of majority)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成人|せいじん}: adult (legal/formal sense)
- {大人|おとな}: adult (general, everyday)
- {成年|せいねん}: age of majority (more legal/formal)
